name: HX711_full_example

expect.contains:
HX711 Demo
Initializing the scale
Before setting up the scale:
read: 		107374
read average: 		107374
get value: 		107374.00
get units: 		107374.0
After setting up the scale:
read: 		107374
read average: 		107374
get value: 		0.00
get units: 		0.0
Readings:
one reading:	0.0	| average:	0.0

one reading:	0.0	| average:	0.0
one reading:	188.4	| average:	188.4

description: The HX711 library's HX711_full_example, unmodified, on an ideal HX711 with a 5 kg, 1 mV/V load cell. Unloaded, the cell's 0.05 mV/V zero balance reads 107374 (0.05e-3 x 128 x 2^24), worked out beforehand, so the readings before tare() are that, and 0 after it. The sketch's scale factor 2280 belongs to its author's cell: 1 kg put on at 10 s, while the chip is powered down, reads 536871 after power_up() and its settling time, and the library prints (536871 - 107374) / 2280 = 188.4 units, as an uncalibrated scale does.
